spec.name: us_se_tax
spec.summary: US self-employment tax (Schedule SE regular method) for tax year 2025 or 2026: 92.35% of net profit, 12.4% social security up to the wage base less W-2 SS wages, 2.9% Medicare uncapped. Excludes the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax (Form 8959).

tax_year.description: the tax year the question is about. This engine has figures for 2025 and 2026 only; any other year is refused

anchors: us-federal-return-assembly Case A: profit $120,000 -> SE tax $16,955.46 (2025), half $8,477.73

rules.name: NET_EARNINGS_FACTOR
rules.quote: Net earnings | Schedule C net profit × 92.35%

rules.name: MIN_NET_EARNINGS
rules.quote: No SE tax | If net earnings (Schedule SE line 4c) are less than $400

rules.name: SS_RATE
rules.quote: Social security part | 12.4% of net earnings, up to the wage base minus social security wages already taxed

rules.name: MEDICARE_RATE
rules.quote: Medicare part | 2.9% of all net earnings, with no cap

rules.name: DEDUCTIBLE_SHARE
rules.quote: Deduction | Half of SE tax (Schedule SE line 13) goes to Schedule 1 line 15
